task_completion.description: The Chinook database is open in the LibreOffice Base application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LibreOffice Base window is visible, showing the Chinook database file name in the title bar or main interface.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a query or SQL command to identify customers with a last purchase date before January 1, 2013.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A SQL editor or Query Design window showing a SELECT statement with 'MAX(InvoiceDate) < '2013-01-01'' or similar logic.

task_completion.description: A new table named 'InactiveCustomers' is created with the specified schema.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Tables' section of LibreOffice Base shows a new table entry named 'InactiveCustomers'.

task_completion.description: The InactiveCustomers table contains the required columns: CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Email, LastPurchaseDate, and LifetimeValue.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The table design view or data view for 'InactiveCustomers' shows these specific column headers.

task_completion.description: The InactiveCustomers table is populated with data based on the query results.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The data view of the 'InactiveCustomers' table shows rows of data (or an attempt to insert them) corresponding to the filtered customer list.

task_completion.description: The database is saved to ensure changes are recorded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' icon is clicked, or the 'File > Save' menu option is selected, and the save progress bar or status change is visible.

integrity.description: The agent used the LibreOffice Base GUI rather than just executing terminal commands to manipulate the database file directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with LibreOffice menus, buttons, and table wizards.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type in customer names and dates from memory or external notes.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using SQL 'INSERT INTO ... SELECT' statements or the 'Copy/Paste' table wizard within the GUI.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Chinook database file provided in the environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file path or database connection settings in LibreOffice Base point to the expected Chinook source file.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target table must be named 'InactiveCustomers'. The cutoff date for inactivity is strictly before 2013-01-01. Note: Due to the specific version of the Chinook dataset used in this environment, all invoice dates are actually between 2021 and 2025. Therefore, a correct query will result in 0 rows. The agent should still be evaluated on the correct creation of the table schema and the logic of the SQL query/filter used, even if the resulting table is empty.
